levels.surface: أبو العباس أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد بن عقدة
أبو عبد الله جعفر بن عبد الله المحمدي

notes: Ishaq relays an account in which Isma'il ibn Ammar is described (وصف إسماعيل) and speaks; he is described rather than the transmitter of the saying, so no link is added for him (rule 6); the Imam speaks last («قال: أما إسماعيل فلا»), so he is the last link (owner ruling 5)
«من كتابه» (from his book) and «يعني الأئمة» are glosses: left out
«أبي عبد الله» occurs twice in the report: this is the second, the one the Imam is reached at (after «حتى انتهى إلى»); the first is the description «لأبي عبد الله دينه», which is not a link
The kunya «أبو عبد الله» of Ja'far al-Muhammadi is a different man from the Imam and is not identified (owner ruling 3)
